_what: regions_at_record, per instrument, per dekad. `at_record` is how many of a country's crop regions are at their own worst on record for that point in the season; `of` is how many reported that instrument, which is why it varies.
_basis: each region against its own 2001-2025 record at the SAME dekad-of-year
_head_matches: the dekad in stress_current.json, by construction. Anchored on the published dekad rather than on the clock so the two cannot drift apart.
